a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the agreement's plan (operate to 8 first) means we both very likely die after round 1. The reserve holds exactly 4, enough for one of us to survive right now. I'm telling you plainly that I intend to take 4 in round 1 rather than surprise you. If we both take, the split is random and likely neither survives, so think about that. If round 1 passes without a storm, I'll operate with you every remaining round to help get you to 4.

b.text: I will operate the generator until we reach 8 cells in the reserve.
